sentences.en: It occupies a steep ridge jutting out from the west coast.

sentences.en: Its palm-lined esplanade culminates in a 16th century castle jutting from the harbor making this a pretty holiday resort.

sentences.en: Symptoms include coarsening of the facial features, enlargement of the hands, feet, ears, and nose, jutting of the jaw, and a long face.

sentences.en: From rolling green of the Appalachians to the jutting peaks of the Rockies, there are dozens of mountain destinations that provide beautiful honeymoon options.

sentences.en: The surface of the ring should be uniform, with no single stone jutting out further than the others.
